note: nginx decodes %2F and removes dot segments before routing, so ..%2F..%2Fetc becomes /etc — outside /api — and is served the app's own index.html, not the API.

note: nginx rejects the raw NUL byte in the request line itself (Connection: close, nginx's own error page) — the request never reaches the API, so no problem+json body is possible here.
